name: The University of Melbourne
description: The University of Melbourne is a public research university founded in 1853, the oldest in Victoria and second-oldest in Australia. It is a member of the Group of Eight and uses a graduate-entry model for professional degrees such as medicine and law.
whyIncluded: Melbourne reports over 500 enrolled students from Singapore, and is a Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: Not a University of Melbourne estimate: the Australian government's minimum living cost for student visas, one combined figure for 12 months, used because no university breakdown could be verified.
livingCosts.notes: FALLBACK - visa minimum, not a University of Melbourne estimate: the Department of Home Affairs student visa living-cost requirement for a single student, AU$29,710 per year (from 10 May 2024) / 12. It is one combined figure for accommodation, food, transport and personal costs, so it is all in housing and the other categories are 0. Melbourne's own cost-of-living pages (study.unimelb.edu.au) block automated access and no breakdown could be verified; the amount was read from UNSW's page citing Home Affairs because the Home Affairs page also blocks scripts.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce
programmes.summary: Typical first-year tuition for international students, the lower end of a range up to A$59,052 that depends on subjects chosen. Read from a third-party copy of the university's fee tables.
programmes.notes: 2026 'typical first year course fee' from Table 2 of the 2026 international fee tables, lower end of the subject-dependent range $52,360 - $59,052 (fees are per subject and depend on the discipline band of the subjects taken; indicative only). 2024 and 2025 from the previous years' international fee tables (same basis). International students pay no SSAF (ask.unimelb.edu.au FAQ 5570). The fee tables are on study.unimelb.edu.au, which blocks automated access (HTTP 403); the official PDFs were read on 2026-10-01 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of these URLs, hence sourceType secondary.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts (Psychology major)
programmes.summary: Typical first-year tuition for international students, the lower end of a range up to A$56,252; psychology subjects are in a dearer fee band. Read from a third-party copy of the university's fee tables.
programmes.notes: Melbourne teaches psychology as a major within the Bachelor of Arts (also the Bachelor of Science), so this is the Bachelor of Arts figure: 2026 'typical first year course fee' from Table 2 of the 2026 international fee tables, lower end of the subject-dependent range $38,004 - $56,252 (same figure and basis as the Bachelor of Arts entry). Psychology subjects are charged in the 'Behavioural Science' subject fee band, A$56,960 per EFTSL in 2026 (Table 1), above the Arts band (A$44,832), so a first year with more psychology subjects costs more than the lower end. History rows copied from the Bachelor of Arts entry (Table 2 of the 2024 and 2025 international fee tables, lower ends A$39,080 and A$37,884). International students pay no SSAF (ask.unimelb.edu.au FAQ 5570). The fee tables are on study.unimelb.edu.au, which blocks automated access (HTTP 403); the official PDFs were read on 2026-10-05 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of these URLs, hence sourceType secondary.
